records.context: the processing session's settings key-value mapping, recorded (hashed) in the model card. Its ``mixed_precision`` structured-data name turns on autocast for training, and its ``train_metrics_full_pass`` structured-data name chooses how the per-epoch training metrics are measured: off (the default), they are accumulated from the training batches themselves, in the mode and precision training uses, while the weights change through the epoch; on, the model is re-evaluated over the whole training loader after each epoch in eval mode and full precision, which costs one more pass over the data. Validation metrics are the same either way. When ``<src>/train`` does not exist, class counts for the loss come from the ``labels`` or ``targets`` attribute of the training dataset.

records.source: the run's settings dict, recorded (hashed) in the model card. Its ``mixed_precision`` key turns on autocast for training, and its ``train_metrics_full_pass`` key chooses how the per-epoch training metrics are measured: off (the default), they are accumulated from the training batches themselves, in the mode and precision training uses, while the weights change through the epoch; on, the model is re-evaluated over the whole training loader after each epoch in eval mode and full precision, which costs one more pass over the data. Validation metrics are the same either way. When ``<src>/train`` does not exist, class counts for the loss come from the ``labels`` or ``targets`` attribute of the training dataset.
records.translation: das Einstellungs-Dict des Laufs, (gehasht) in der Modellkarte festgehalten. Sein Schlüssel ``mixed_precision`` schaltet Autocast für das Training ein, und sein Schlüssel ``train_metrics_full_pass`` legt fest, wie die Trainingsmetriken pro Epoche gemessen werden: aus (Standard) werden sie aus den Trainingsbatches selbst akkumuliert, in dem Modus und der Präzision, die das Training verwendet, während sich die Gewichte im Verlauf der Epoche ändern; ein wird das Modell nach jeder Epoche im Eval-Modus und mit voller Präzision über den gesamten Trainings-Loader erneut ausgewertet, was einen weiteren Durchlauf über die Daten kostet. Die Validierungsmetriken sind in beiden Fällen gleich. Existiert ``<src>/train`` nicht, stammen die Klassenanzahlen für die Verlustfunktion aus dem Attribut ``labels`` oder ``targets`` des Trainingsdatensatzes.

Each distinct value is held out once, so there is one fold per value and ``n_splits`` is not used. ``plate``, ``well`` and ``field`` come from the extracted image region names; any other column is looked up by well in ``metadata_path``. ``group_by`` still names the identity that may not cross a fold, and the fold table gains a ``held_out`` column.

records.source: metadata column for leave-one-group-out folds, such as a compound. Each distinct value is held out once, so there is one fold per value and ``n_splits`` is not used. ``plate``, ``well`` and ``field`` come from the crop names; any other column is looked up by well in ``metadata_path``. ``group_by`` still names the identity that may not cross a fold, and the fold table gains a ``held_out`` column.
records.translation: Metadatenspalte für Leave-one-group-out-Folds, etwa eine Verbindung. Jeder unterschiedliche Wert wird einmal zurückgehalten, sodass es einen Fold pro Wert gibt und ``n_splits`` nicht verwendet wird. ``plate``, ``well`` und ``field`` stammen aus den Namen der Bildausschnitte; jede andere Spalte wird über das Well in ``metadata_path`` nachgeschlagen. ``group_by`` benennt weiterhin die Identität, die keinen Fold überschreiten darf, und die Fold-Tabelle erhält eine Spalte ``held_out``.

records.context: metadata column naming each sample's batch, such as a laboratory microplate or an imaging week. Each fold's training side then drops every sample from a batch present in its validation side, so a held-out sample is never scored by a model that saw its batch (the not-same-compound-or-batch rule when ``group_column`` is a compound). The fold table gains ``held_out_batches``, ``n_train_excluded`` and ``train_classes_missing``.
records.label: spacr.io.generate_cv_loaders#20
records.source: metadata column naming each sample's batch, such as a plate or an imaging week. Each fold's training side then drops every sample from a batch present in its validation side, so a held-out sample is never scored by a model that saw its batch (the not-same-compound-or-batch rule when ``group_column`` is a compound). The fold table gains ``held_out_batches``, ``n_train_excluded`` and ``train_classes_missing``.
records.translation: Metadatenspalte, die den Batch jeder Probe benennt, etwa eine Platte oder eine Bildgebungswoche. Die Trainingsseite jedes Folds verwirft dann jede Probe aus einem Batch, der auf seiner Validierungsseite vorkommt, sodass eine zurückgehaltene Probe nie von einem Modell bewertet wird, das ihren Batch gesehen hat (die Regel „nicht dieselbe Verbindung oder derselbe Batch“, wenn ``group_column`` eine Verbindung ist). Die Fold-Tabelle erhält ``held_out_batches``, ``n_train_excluded`` und ``train_classes_missing``.
